purpose: Independent consumer-insurance evidence retrieval and grounded QA; historical tests remain regression-only.
quality_gate: At least1000 independent TEST, all existing source/split/task/family/rights/contamination gates pass; accepted0 until then. Never restore holds to meet quotas.

selection_scope.data: Only source-separated accepted DEV; existing minimum50 and per-task/family minima unchanged. Current58 is provisional, not an adequate sample for broad model superiority claims.
selection_scope.training: No new fine-tuning scheduled. Existing query/reranker weights are fixed inherited artifacts; never train on holdout DEV/TEST or their source families.
selection_scope.candidate_grid: Six registered retrieval arms only; no post-TEST grid expansion.
selection_scope.primary: Document-family macro complete-evidence@5 on answerable DEV
selection_scope.lock: Write immutable selection lock with DEV data, corpus, model/tokenizer, code, prompt, packing, rubric and configuration hashes before any TEST model inference. Content-curation inspection is disclosed and must not guide inference tuning.

arms.query: 50/50 normalized original and inherited seed42/epoch2 query blend
50/50 normalized original and inherited seed42/epoch2 query blend

retrieval_contract.document_encoder: Unchanged BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, normalized CLS,512token limit; all arms share corpus and vectors.
retrieval_contract.reranker: Inherited MiniLM-L6-v2 evidence reranker seed123/epoch2; exact weight/tokenizer fingerprints verified before use.
retrieval_contract.candidate_budget: Dense top100 plus positive-score BM25 top100 union<=200; deterministic score/ID ties. Sparse/dense solo arms return their own ranks.
retrieval_contract.fusion: Existing per-query min-max score fusion; dense.8 + lexical.2; reranked arms blend fused score.5 + cross.5.
retrieval_contract.corpus_scope: Global search over a source-only, permission-cleared corpus. No gold-document filter, evidence-only corpus, answer-key chunking, synthetic reference answers or label-guided candidate insertion.
retrieval_contract.corpus_gate: Source-only inclusion manifest and deterministic chunking must be reviewed/hashed before DEV scoring. Preserve table headers and qualifiers; exclude third-party/permission-held text. Catalog existence alone is not corpus clearance.
retrieval_contract.relevance: Freeze chunk IDs and all reviewed alternative support labels before model results. Binary annotated-chunk nDCG@10 and Recall@5 are label-based. Separately require every necessary evidence unit for complete-evidence@5; aliases cannot multiply independent evidence units. Mapping validation is still pending.
retrieval_contract.refusals: Do not treat citations supporting an information gap as answer-relevance gold. Retrieval recall/nDCG/complete metrics N/A for refusal task; report gap-context retrieval separately with that diagnostic label.

generation.prompt: Reuse research mode of answer_evidence_reranker; freeze exact prompt and guards on DEV. No adaptive model substitution or paid fallback.
generation.test_comparisons: Run dense_original and DEV-selected arm on all frozen TEST cases; if selected=dense_original, only one unique generation run. Retrieval all6 arms. Shared retrieved context may be cached only when exact prompt/model/parameters match.
generation.trace: Keep exact supplied evidence, prompt, raw output, served output, guard alterations, errors, truncation, model digest, timing and token counts private. Inferencer receives id/question/retrieved context only; no task label, answer, formula, gap annotations or gold spans.
generation.runtime_status: Historical Ollama endpoints timed out and usual installation/model manifest absent on resume; awaiting current path/address. No new generation performed.

retrieval: Recall@5=annotated relevant chunks retrieved/annotated relevant chunks
complete evidence retained after context packing
generation: citation ID validity distinct from claim support
citation support precision over emitted claim-citation pairs and citation completeness over factual claims
metrics.denominators: Publish exact N, valid outputs, failures, numerators and denominators per task and arm. Retrieval/generation failures remain in intended answerable denominators as zero; refusal failures are not successful abstentions. Undefined ratios are null, never zero or100%. Raw/served evaluated separately.
metrics.semantic_review: Before TEST inference select100paired cases,25per task, deterministically by seeded family-stratified sampling, at most2per family per task. Freeze IDs and rubric. Codex content review of support/citation claims on this subset only, not expert review and not whole-test accuracy; lexical checks on all outputs are separately labeled proxies. Record unresolved judgments and sensitivity bounds.
metrics.statistics: Paired whole-document-family cluster bootstrap2000draws seed42; report question-macro and equal-family macro separately. Ratios such as refusal precision bootstrap summed numerator/denominator, not mean per-row ratios. Few-family strata carry explicit uncertainty limits. No independent-question CI, hidden denominator reduction or universal-superiority claim.
metrics.cost: Log cold setup separately, warm query encode/retrieve/rerank/generate timings, p50/p95, total elapsed, actual token counts and hardware/library versions. Shared-desktop results are observations, not production latency guarantees.

execution_gates: Finish candidate quality and source-only corpus/relevance mapping
Verify current local Qwen runtime and model digest
Run DEV only and freeze selection/rubric/code
Global quality acceptance>=1000 then immutable TEST/corpus/code/model/prompt freeze
Run registered TEST arms once with resumable exact-hash outputs; no tuning from results
Publish aggregates/code/tests only; verify exact-head CI; do not merge
results_status: No new DEV comparison, TEST inference, final metrics, frozen dataset or end-to-end success claimed by this protocol.
